source_title: Solid State PLC Annual Report and Accounts 2019
availability_evidence: Annual report pages 51 and 93 state that the financial statements were approved by the Board of Directors and authorised for issue on 2 July 2019; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue rose 22% to £56.3m, adjusted operating profit increased more than 20%, gross margin improved from 27.5% to 29.1% and underlying operating cash flow rose to £4.0m. The open order book increased 56% to £35.9m. Net cash moved to £2.0m net debt following the Pacer acquisition and inventory investment, but net assets strengthened and cash conversion remained above 100%.
already_announced_exclusion: The completed Manufacturing division reorganisation and refocus, Pacer acquisition and associated facility and process initiatives disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Record revenue and profit, improving gross margins, high cash conversion and a much larger order book provide strong quantified evidence against pressure; modest acquisition-related debt is the only material offset.

source_title: Solid State PLC Annual Report and Accounts 2021
availability_evidence: Annual report pages 73 and 122 state that the financial statements were approved by the Board of Directors and authorised for issue on 13 July 2021; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue was broadly stable despite COVID-19 and like-for-like revenue fell 3.6%, but adjusted operating margin rose 110bps to 8.3%, adjusted profit before tax rose 14.9% and the open order book increased 34.6% to £51.0m. Underlying operating cash flow remained £6.9m; acquisition consideration changed the reported position from £3.2m net cash to £4.4m net debt, while bank cash remained £3.1m.
already_announced_exclusion: The Willow and Active acquisitions, associated non-recurring redundancy and acquisition costs, and completed efficiency scaling disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Minor pandemic-related revenue pressure was outweighed by record profit, higher margins, resilient cash generation, bank cash and a substantially stronger order book.

source_title: Solid State PLC Annual Report and Accounts 2023
availability_evidence: Annual report pages 86 and 126 state that the financial statements were approved by the Board of Directors and authorised for issue on 4 July 2023; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue rose 49% to £126.5m, including 18% organic constant-currency growth; adjusted operating profit rose to £11.6m, margin increased from 8.7% to 9.2% and adjusted profit before tax rose 50% to £10.8m. Operating cash inflow increased to £9.4m and the order book reached £116.2m. Net debt increased to £8.1m after the Custom Power acquisition and strategic inventory investment, with strong second-half cash conversion and planned inventory unwind.
already_announced_exclusion: The Custom Power, Active Silicon and Willow acquisitions, completed integration work and planned legacy mercury-equipment decommissioning disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Record organic and reported growth, rising profit and margin, strong second-half cash conversion and a larger order book provide multiple quantified offsets; acquisition and inventory-related debt is contained and explained.
